{{Quote|Ari Skyff, captain of the Corvani. Or I was, until the Imperials got her in their sights.|Ari Skyff|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ari Skyff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]] he was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[NX-1200]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Corvani]]'' and went on a mission to deliver medical supplies and [[X-22 blaster rifle]]s to the Republic on the war-torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. However, he was shot down by the Empire and was stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He tasked a Republic citizen with recovering the supplies he was supposed to deliver, as well as a piece of his ship's hull as a memento.

After receiving the requested items, Skyff remained stuck on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Trying to earn money, he started flying for the [[Balmorran resistance]], naming the vessel they assigned to him the ''[[Corvana]]''. He later send a letter of thanks to the spacer who helped him in the hour of need.
